name: add_tasktracker_task_comments
description: L3 repo-scale: add a Comment sub-resource to tasks across models/schemas/crud/routers
prompts: This is the fastapi-tasktracker repo (FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.0, layered as app/models, app/schemas, app/crud, app/routers - see README.md for the layout). Add commenting on tasks: a new Comment entity with an integer id, a `body` string, `task_id` (FK to tasks.id) and `author_id` (FK to users.id). Wire it through every layer the existing entities use: a SQLAlchemy model registered the same way User/Project/Task are (so its table is created), a Pydantic CommentCreate (body, author_id) and CommentOut (id, body, task_id, author_id) pair, a crud module with create_comment(db, task_id, data) and list_comments(db, task_id) returning comments for a task in creation order (oldest first), and two endpoints on the existing tasks router: POST /tasks/{task_id}/comments and GET /tasks/{task_id}/comments. Both must 404 (raise HTTPException(status_code=404)) when task_id doesn't correspond to an existing task.

test_setup_files.tests/test_comments_hidden.py:
def _setup(client):
    user = client.post("/users", json={"username": "u1", "email": "u1@example.com"}).json()
    project = client.post("/projects", json={"name": "Voyager", "owner_id": user["id"]}).json()
    task = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Plan launch", "project_id": project["id"]}).json()
    return user, task


def test_create_and_list_comments_in_order(client):
    user, task = _setup(client)
    task_id = task["id"]

    resp = client.post(f"/tasks/{task_id}/comments", json={"body": "first", "author_id": user["id"]})
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    comment = resp.json()
    assert comment["body"] == "first"
    assert comment["author_id"] == user["id"]
    assert comment["task_id"] == task["id"]

    client.post(f"/tasks/{task_id}/comments", json={"body": "second", "author_id": user["id"]})
    client.post(f"/tasks/{task_id}/comments", json={"body": "third", "author_id": user["id"]})

    resp = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}/comments")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    bodies = [c["body"] for c in resp.json()]
    assert bodies == ["first", "second", "third"], bodies


def test_comments_on_missing_task_404(client):
    resp = client.get("/tasks/999999/comments")
    assert resp.status_code == 404

    resp = client.post("/tasks/999999/comments", json={"body": "x", "author_id": 1})
    assert resp.status_code == 404

reference_solution.app/crud/comment.py:
from __future__ import annotations

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models.comment import Comment
from app.schemas.comment import CommentCreate


def create_comment(db: Session, task_id: int, data: CommentCreate) -> Comment:
    comment = Comment(body=data.body, task_id=task_id, author_id=data.author_id)
    db.add(comment)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(comment)
    return comment


def list_comments(db: Session, task_id: int) -> list[Comment]:
    stmt = select(Comment).where(Comment.task_id == task_id).order_by(Comment.id)
    return list(db.scalars(stmt))
